Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifier, compound name, and canonical SMILES for all molecules mentioned in the specified document. Filter to only include molecules with available canonical SMILES. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, and finally to compound_structures on molregno. Filter by document ChEMBL ID. Order results by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
